## Summary
P20.1 replaces the four overlapping backlogs (risk-register deferred-class tables, ADR revisit triggers, `LEDGER_DEFERRALS.md`, `CHECKLIST_ITEMS→None`) with **one** normalized, committed backlog where every source id lands in exactly one item, and publishes the operational-readiness map (DECISION_MEMO §6 → checkable capability × {code, rights, infra, human} matrix + critical path to Oklahoma City live). **Docs + one stdlib script; no code change.** Stacked on `devin/p19-5-capstone-gap-closure`.

## What changed
- **`docs/build/BACKLOG.csv`** — 50 items (`bl_id,title,type,sources,req_ids,package,blocks,landing,gate,size,status`). Every **deferred RISK row (100)**, **ADR revisit trigger (61)**, and **LD row (90)** = 251 sources, each in exactly one `sources` cell (defining standard §3.1: no orphans, no double-owned sources).
- **`docs/build/BACKLOG.md`** — grouped by `landing`, with a "P22+ unscheduled" section (7 items, recorded not guessed).
- **`docs/build/BACKLOG_THEMES.md`** — 10 themes; every `bl_id` in exactly one.
- **`docs/build/tools/check_backlog.py`** — stdlib validator, **PR-invoked docs tool (not a `make check` step — the RISK-P20-01 compensating control)**.
- **`docs/risk_register.md`** — append-only ` → BL-nnn` suffix on the first cell of each of the 100 mapped RISK rows (no other edit); new `## Phase 20 — Backlog & readiness (P20.1)` with **RISK-P20-01**. ADR files untouched.
- **`docs/build/CAPSTONE_CLOSURE.md` §(e)** — HG-14 signature written.
- **`docs/build/OPERATIONAL_READINESS.md`** — §(a) capability map incl. one row per connector (9) with live rights counts; §(b) OKC minimum viable slice; §(c) 9-step critical path (each `ticket:`+`proof:`, no TBD); §(d) HG-01..14 (roles, never names — Part VIII §0.7); §(e) cost posture.
- **`docs/traceability.md`** — Phase 20 section.
